dict.string: Friday listens for its wake word (“Jarvis”) and for what you say afterwards. Audio is analysed on this Mac; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere unless you connect a cloud model and ask it something.
Friday turns your spoken requests into text with Apple’s on-device speech recognition.
Friday uses Apple Events for the actions you ask for in Music, Notes, Mail, Messages, Safari, Chrome, System Events and system audio. You can allow each application separately.
Friday needs Calendar access to show, create, move and cancel events when you ask it to.
Friday needs Reminders access to create, show, complete and delete reminders when you ask it to.
Friday uses Contacts to find people and their details when you ask. Creating or changing a contact requires your confirmation.
Friday takes a screenshot only when you ask about what is on your screen.
Friday uses Accessibility to read on-screen elements, click, type and arrange windows when you ask it to.
Friday uses your location only for local weather when you ask about the weather without naming a place.
